name: Velvet Armchair
description: Mid-Century Modern armchair attributed to Finn Juhl. Olive velvet upholstery with teak armrests.

name: Porcelain & Gold Vase
description: Hand-painted porcelain vase with intricate 24k gold leaf detailing. Royal Worcester manufacture.

name: Stained Glass Lamp
description: Art Deco figural table lamp with handcrafted stained glass shade. Attributed to Edgar Brandt.

name: Brass Carriage Clock
description: Fine brass carriage clock with 8-day French movement. White porcelain dial with Roman numerals.

name: Mahogany Writing Desk
description: Georgian mahogany pedestal writing desk with leather insert top and brass handles.

name: Studio Pottery Bowl
description: Mid-century studio pottery bowl with organic glazes. Lucie Rie studio.

name: Crystal & Bronze Chandelier
description: Art Deco crystal and bronze chandelier with six lights. Atelier Ruhlmann.

name: Silver Tea Service
description: Victorian silver tea service with ornate repoussé detailing. Garrard & Co.
